coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 11 ground-truth items (27%): ZB-2p scheduling with an ideal-versus-measured comparison, computed versus profiled execution timelines, and bubble rate as an outcome.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed 16-stage, 64-microbatch experiment with a variable P/M grid and additional schedules. Omits the specified 14.6B model configuration, exact zero-bubble settings, and Nsight Systems/export/SVG workflow. Measuring communication overlap is not the specified complete-overlap theoretical assumption. Throughput in samples/second/GPU and explicit ideal-to-actual timeline alignment are not reported as dependent measures.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expectation of near-zero bubbles (less than 1% in most settings), slightly higher measured bubbles from overhead, and supporting evidence from high throughput and tight execution-timeline alignment.
